rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for money or goods collected by a government.

example.english: This tax is used to maintain public services.
example.traditional: 呢項稅係用嚟維持公共服務㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 seoi3 hai6 jung6 lei4 wai4 ci4 gung1 gung6 fuk6 mou6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a burdensome demand or strain on something such as time or health.

example.english: This job puts a heavy tax on my health.
example.traditional: 呢份工作對我嘅健康係一個好大嘅負擔。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 gin6 hong1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 fu6 daam1
